answer: Each identity binds one app-store developer account: Apple charges $99 yearly and checks a government ID first, one per person. The store signs a whisper receipt into the Ocean registry with a 20 POA bond locked 180 days. A second account from the same card or device triggers a 30-day manual review, so each extra fake needs a fresh card and device and marginal cost climbs. 100 fakes cost $9,900 a year plus 100 ID checks. Each renewal appends a thread to the registry; a lapse over 14 days freezes payouts and slashes half the bond. Without the program, Google Play needs a 40 POA bond.
